title: Formal bi-entire coefficient majorant for actual Q3 local words
question: Can the actual onsite, Q3-edge and spatial-bond potential differences be controlled by a formal coefficient norm with independent field and source radii, without a finite field cutoff?

model.local_choices: one onsite plus three Q3 edges plus six spatial bonds
model.word_bound: C(R,S)^n for length-n coefficient words; factorial EGF exp(t*C(R,S))
model.interpretation: formal analytic/Frechet coefficient candidate; R is not a pointwise field cutoff

scoped_verdict: The exact actual local Q3 potential differences have finite bi-entire coefficient norms. Their endpoint reversals have equal norms. Summing one onsite, three Q3-edge and six bond choices gives C(R,S), and coefficient-word submultiplicativity gives C(R,S)^n and exp(t*C(R,S)).

adversarial_review.check: R and S are coefficient-norm radii, not a claim that the physical fields are bounded.
The formal l1 norm does not prove q^3 A^(-3/4), CCR domain invariance, or Duhamel convergence.
Submultiplicativity is for formal polynomial coefficients; no representation-independent completion is constructed.
Absolute coefficient reversal is not an adjoint-history or KMS statement.
The local choice count is bounded-degree; no spatial first-passage or exhaustion estimate follows.
R223 checks exact rational fixture arithmetic only.
No OS/KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion follows.

scope.closed: Formal bi-entire coefficient-level word envelope for actual local Q3 potential differences and both endpoint orientations.
scope.not_closed: Representation-independent common-core completion, energy/state bridge, actual repeated commutators, spatial first-passage, exhaustion, common alpha, KMS, ground/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

next_action: Define and test a representation-independent completion of this bi-entire coefficient topology on the Q3 common core; then prove the actual six-neighbour/two-orientation recurrence and spatial Cauchy estimate.
no_overclaim: This package proves only a formal coefficient-level analytic candidate. It does not prove Q3 operator dynamics, thermodynamic QFT, common alpha, KMS, a GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
